examples.title: Typography variants
examples.description: Each variant renders its matching element: h1 to h5 headings, and paragraphs for caption and body.
examples.code: Heading 1 Heading 2 Heading 3 Heading 4 Heading 5 Body text is the default variant. Caption text for supporting detail.

examples.title: Overriding the element
examples.description: The as prop swaps the rendered element while keeping the variant style, for example a visually large h2 inside a section.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Text } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<article style="display: grid; gap: var(--cinder-space-2);">
  <Text variant="h1" as="h2">Styled as h1, rendered as h2</Text>
  <Text variant="caption" as="span">Inline caption</Text>
</article>

examples.title: Inherited color
examples.description: Text takes its color from the container, so it follows any surface it is placed on.
examples.code: Inherits from the container The color comes from the surrounding element.

examples.title: Clamped run with Show all
examples.description: A long run holds to three lines; Show all opens the rest in place and the page's own link sits beside it.
examples.code: {reply} {#snippet actions()} Show raw payloads {/snippet}

examples.title: Cut in the middle
examples.description: A long identifier keeps its last four characters when the line is too narrow; the tooltip carries the whole id.
